Generated encrypted keys and private loopback sshd only; fixture main thread supplies bounded answers. Eight auth/cancel/host-key/wait cases, 1.5s answer wait with 1s network timeout. No Workspace/GUI, native IME, transfer jobs, Windows, same-workload performance or idle-cost claim.
